tagline: Build with AI. Review precisely. Generate your way.
shortDescription: A visual UI workspace for AI-assisted design, precise review, and developer-controlled generation.
description: Turn a product idea into an interface you can inspect and refine. Yuntu Editor brings local UI authoring, AI-assisted editing, targeted review, and structured developer handoff into one visual workspace.
Build pages with editable layers, text, images, buttons, and containers. Refine geometry and appearance, organize local assets, and check supported content in preview.

Connect a compatible external AI client to inspect and edit the real project. Follow changes in Yuntu, compare supported before-and-after views, and leave review comments on specific elements to guide the next revision.

Export versioned JSON and mappings for your development workflow. Enable the optional official Web exporter for its supported React and TypeScript output, or use a compatible generation program that fits your project. Application logic, services, and deployment remain part of your own development process.

The current beta centers on local Windows x64 projects. AI assistance requires a separately configured compatible client and model access; provider charges are separate. Preview and export support varies by content and target. Production accounts, subscriptions, hosted collaboration, and cloud project storage are not announced as available features.
features: Create and refine local UI pages with editable layers, text, images, buttons, and containers.
Connect a compatible external AI client to inspect and edit the real project.
Attach precise review feedback to specific elements and inspect review history.
Preview supported page interactions and animation workflows.
Export versioned JSON, source mappings, and required resources for developer handoff.
Use a compatible generator, including the optional official Web exporter for supported content.
